name: Tusass TopUp Talk
steps: Click escape button to show the - Login with password  - button
Click the - Login with password  - button
Extract the external id from this customer page
Note the old balance on this page
Take the screenshot of that page and save it as - search-result.png -
In the topup talk page, Enter your phone number ${PHONE_NUMBER} in the input box
In the same page , Enter your Mobile number ${MOBILE_NUMBER} in the input box
After payment is successful, it show the Recipt page, take the screenshot of that page and save it as - receipt.png -
IN that page current balance should be updated with topup amount, take the screenshot of that page and save it as - updated-balance.png -
Note the new balance on this page after topup
Verify the balance is updated by comparing the current balance with previous balance and topup amount - ${TOPUP_AMOUNT} -
Give the report - Tusass topup talk flow is executed successfully. ${SUBSCRIBER_EXTERNAL_ID} is topped up with amount ${TOPUP_AMOUNT}. Balance before: ${OLD_BALANCE} — Balance after: ${NEW_BALANCE}
